what_it_is: Remove the deprecated --cgroups no-op flag and hard-error when it is supplied
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 implements the same hard error in py/dagrun/cli.py and rs/dagrun/src/cli.rs via dfefbdb8; the obsolete flag is not silently accepted. Goalposts strengthened, not lowered.

what_it_is: Add host-wide memory-primary admission control
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 has the successor flock plus PID/starttime admission mechanism in py/dagrun/admission.py, introduced by 14bc7cfc and hardened by 7cd8768b; this supersedes the rescued implementation. Goalposts strengthened against PID reuse.

what_it_is: Make supervisor-thread exceptions fail the run loudly
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 has exception handoff plus dead-supervisor sweeping in py/dagrun/scheduler.py and regression coverage in py/tests/test_supervisor_crash.py via 4e21c85 and Rust parity pin e43dd15. No failure is relabeled as pass.

what_it_is: Set nonzero default resource caps for SMALL jobs
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 068ac92f; current defaults are present in Python and Rust model.py/model.rs and activated by ada564d. This adds enforcement rather than weakening a threshold.

what_it_is: Add an initial stateful IRQ-aware core allocator using process affinity
basis: Intermediate old design, later amended by ff16cc3b and 4be959a4, and superseded on current main 9bb6b665 by durable flock-ledger plus systemd AllowedCPUs hard cpusets in cpuset_allocator.py/reservation.py (f3c526, e0427b, a59892, d1f7fd). Recovering sched_setaffinity would lower isolation.

what_it_is: Wire memory admission into run_dag execution
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 calls _apply_admission before scheduling and releases it in py/dagrun/cli.py; the underlying admission is the stronger 14bc7cfc/7cd8768b successor. No case is skipped.

what_it_is: Expose memory admission policy through --admission
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 exposes --admission in py/dagrun/cli.py and applies the stronger admission implementation. Policy remains an explicit gate; no comparator or failure label was relaxed.

what_it_is: Set nonzero default resource caps for SMALL jobs, duplicate rescue
basis: Same patch-id as rescued 0cfa1c94 and exact current-main patch 068ac92f; current Python/Rust defaults retain the caps. Duplicate object has no additional recovery content and does not lower goalposts.

what_it_is: Update landing-context schema test to use the recognized cancel-in-progress mechanism
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 7c532d4f; current test uses a recognized enum while separate negative tests keep unknown mechanisms UNCLASSIFIED. This is not relabeling unknown as pass.

what_it_is: Enforce cpu_timeout in both Python and Rust execution engines
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 0eb4203a; current engines and tests retain CPU-time enforcement when containment supports it. Enforcement was added, not weakened.

what_it_is: Gate old allocator IRQ-confound checks on designated affinity
basis: Final amendment of the obsolete sched_setaffinity allocator; current main 9bb6b665 instead requires verifiable systemd hard cpusets and ranks measured device-interrupt rates in cpuset_allocator.py/reservation.py. Reintroducing the old exemption would weaken isolation.

what_it_is: Add an inert known_failures configuration field intended to allowlist failures
basis: Rescue adds only a field, with no parser, scheduler behavior, or tests; current main 9bb6b665 explicitly rejects known_failures input in Python and Rust. Its stated intent would relabel failures as non-failing, so the unsatisfied goalpost-lowering fragment must not be recovered.

what_it_is: Treat an absent resource cap as absent rather than numeric zero
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 implements the successor semantics in py/dagrun/model.py and scheduler preflight, with py/tests/test_absent_is_not_zero.py from dccc1a83. This prevents accidental zero-cap failure without widening an explicit cap.

what_it_is: Add the --unsafe-no-cgroups opt-out on an alternate base
basis: Duplicate/superseded version of d9d94370; the latter landed exactly as current-main a8fc13ea and current Python/Rust tests cover the explicit unsafe opt-out. No unique mechanism remains to recover.

what_it_is: Add a per-platform CPU-timeout multiplier
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 retains cpu_timeout_multiplier parsing and resolution in py/dagrun/model.py and CLI via 438535ee plus type integration eb4cf. The multiplier is explicit platform policy, not an unreviewed tolerance widening.

what_it_is: Fetch pull-request heads in one bulk operation
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 70d5adfe and the bulk collection remains in py/pr_landing_planner/collect.py. Operational batching does not change acceptance gates.

what_it_is: Add best-effort procfs process-group CPU accounting for unboxed runs
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 intentionally reports cpu_timeout=false for uncontained execution in capabilities.py and warns rather than claiming enforcement; rescue proccpu.py admits setsid escape, exited-descendant loss, and sampling overshoot, while tests cover only one spinner/sleeper. Hermit main pins 8b0e2c0 and uses --allow-cgroup-failure. Adopting this would relabel best-effort undercount as enforced unless the contract and escape/reaping tests are redesigned.

what_it_is: Prototype a derived capability registry and marker-file solo_validate admission
basis: Research/WIP is superseded by lane-aware capabilities.py and flock plus PID/starttime admission.py on current main 9bb6b665. The prototype has scan-then-acquire TOCTOU, PID-reuse exposure, and falsely advertises unboxed cpu_timeout=true; recovery would weaken truthful capability gating.

what_it_is: Lazy-load PyYAML so dependency-free CLI paths still run
basis: Current main 9bb6b665 has the broader lazy YAML implementation and dependency-negative smoke tests in py/dagrun/io.py and test_cli_smoke_no_optional_deps.py via fddb44d2. Required YAML paths still fail when unavailable, so no check is skipped.

what_it_is: Add positive and negative tests for the planner mechanism enum pipeline
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 29bf8b6c; current planner tests cover recognized mechanisms and preserve UNCLASSIFIED for unknowns. Tests raise coverage rather than lowering assertions.

what_it_is: Derive wall timeout as three times cpu_timeout when wall timeout is omitted
basis: Raw rescue over-tightens small CPU budgets by replacing the prior 1800-second default; current main 9bb6b665 kept the useful derivation in 6f991dd then fixed it in 54e93ab by flooring at 1800 in model.py. The later floor preserves the original requirement rather than moving its goalpost; raw commit is superseded.

what_it_is: Normalize planner mechanisms into an enum and symbol derivation pipeline
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 276009a5 and current mechanism.py/graph/emit retain it. Production diff-to-symbol wiring remains absent, as the commit itself described, but all rescued content is present; no gate was weakened.

what_it_is: Add an explicit --unsafe-no-cgroups opt-out
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main a8fc13ea; current Python/Rust CLI and smoke tests retain the explicitly named unsafe override. The default safety gate remains intact.

what_it_is: Archive every generated landing plan
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 8d5e4fdf and current planner CLI retains archive creation. This changes evidence retention, not pass/fail criteria.

what_it_is: Document mechanism as a semantic planner dimension
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main 9462812c and the documentation remains. It does not relax classification; unknown mechanisms remain explicitly unclassified.

what_it_is: Render UNCLASSIFIED candidates in planner output
basis: Exact patch-id is current-main e1ce5feb and current output retains explicit UNCLASSIFIED rendering. This exposes rather than hides classification failure.

what_it_is: Teach the old IRQ-confound scan to recognize kworker and N:M affinity
basis: Intermediate fix atop 15dbf809 and before 4be959a4; entire process-affinity allocator was superseded by current-main hard cpuset allocation and measured IRQ-rate ranking. Recovering the old scan adds no missing safety and could imply weaker affinity is sufficient.
